name: Height of Rome
description: August 117: Trajan is dead, Hadrian takes the purple and the Roman Empire stands at its greatest extent, while Parthia recovers Mesopotamia, the Kushans rule the road to India and Eastern Han China faces the Xianbei on the steppe.
approximations: Borders follow modern admin-1 provinces, so frontiers such as the Rhine-Danube limes, Hadrian's later wall line, the Parthian marches and the Han frontier are drawn at province resolution. Populations, output (1990 international dollars) and army sizes are rounded estimates with wide uncertainty. Ancient polities are simplified: tribal confederations (Germanic peoples, Sarmatians, Xianbei, Caledonians, Irish kingdoms, Wa, Samhan) are shown as single chiefdom-style states with abs_monarchy government; the Maya city-states are one polity; Saba and Himyar are merged; Kushan and Western Satrap chronology around 117 is uncertain. Peoples outside states (most of the Americas, sub-Saharan Africa, Siberia, the forest zone, Arabia's interior, the Sahara, Tibet, the Tarim basin after the Han withdrawal of 107) are shown as unclaimed land. Flags are invented simple standards.
